question: Which of the following sportsperson is associated with fencing?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**C.A. Bhavani Devi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **C.A. Bhavani Devi** is the first Indian fencer to qualify for the **Olympics.**
 
• She represented India in fencing at the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics.**
 
• Fencing is a **combat sport** involving swords, and Bhavani Devi competes in the **individual sabre event.**
 
• She has won several medals in international competitions such as the **Commonwealth Fencing Championships** and the **Asian Championships.**
 
• Bhavani Devi has been a trailblazer in fencing for India, inspiring many young athletes to consider the sport.
 
• She trained in various countries like **Italy and France**, which are hubs for fencing expertise.
 
• The sport of fencing has three main categories: **foil, sabre, and épée**, and Bhavani specializes in the sabre category.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Navjeet Kaur Dhillon**__

 __
 
• **Navjeet Kaur Dhillon** is an Indian athlete specializing in **discus throw.**
 
• She won a **bronze medal** at the **2018 Commonwealth Games** held in Gold Coast, Australia.
 
• She is one of India's prominent names in track and field events, specifically in **discus throw competitions.**
 
 
 
• **Parul Chowdhary**__
 __
 
• **Parul Chowdhary** is an Indian athlete who competes in **middle-distance running events** like the **1500 meters and 3000 meters steeplechase.**
 
• She has represented India in various international competitions and is known for her exceptional **stamina and speed.**
 
 
 
• **Hima Das**__
 
 
• **Hima Das** is popularly known as the **Dhing Express** and is an Indian sprinter.
 
• She is the first Indian athlete to win a **gold medal in a track event** at the **IAAF World U20 Championships.**
 
• Hima specializes in the **400 meters sprint** and has brought laurels to India in various international events.
